reader.requirement: At --std 85 GENERATE takes exactly one operand, data-name-1 (a detail report group name, optionally qualified by a report-name, never subscripted) or report-name-1, and refuses any other shape.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002: the report-name form also needs no more than one detail group (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6); not the format shape
DialectLevel < 2002 picks the citation text of the ambiguity message only

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the format shape is the same at every edition; only the report-name form's detail-count rule (another rule) differs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise GENERATE data-name and the homonym qualification; GENERATE report-name (summary), IN as the qualifier and the refusal shapes are not exercised

probes.printed: report: DET-A / DET-B / DET-A / CF-C / CF-C; declaratives ran before DET-A, DET-B, DET-A, CF-C, CF-C
probes.expected: GENERATE DET-A, GENERATE DET-B OF R-1, GENERATE DET-A IN R-1 present the details; GENERATE R-2 twice is summary processing (no DET-C), the CY change breaks to CF-C, TERMINATE gives CF-C again

probes.printed: COBOL1757 GENERATE R-2 OF R-1: names neither a detail report group nor a report description entry
probes.expected: refused: a report-name is not qualified

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR1  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1 [quote: may be qualified by a report-name]
OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.1: The GENERATE statement directs the report writer control system to produce a report ... [quote: directs the report writer control system to produce a report]

reader.notes: The format box (GENERATE {data-name-1 | report-name-1}) has fewer than four words, so cite.py cannot check a quotation inside §1985:XIII.4.3.2 itself; the function and SR1 citations were checked. One grammar rule and one resolution funnel serve every edition.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 with a homonym detail group DET-A in two reports and a CF with a SUM counter SC: gc1 GENERATE DET-A IN R-2, GENERATE DET-A OF R-1, GENERATE R-2 (summary) accepted, report DET-C / DET-A / 002 (sum counter added on the report-name GENERATE too). Refusals: gb1 qualified group with ref-mod (COBOL2269), gb2 two qualifier levels DET-A OF R-1 OF RPT (COBOL0307), gb3 unqualified homonym (COBOL1920, cites §1985:IV.4.3.8.1), gb4 a working-storage item and gb5 a sum counter (COBOL1757), gb6 a literal (COBOL5506), gb7 report-name without CONTROL and with two details (COBOL0899 + COBOL6823, the SR2 arms). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR1 [may be qualified by a report-name].
